2018A&A...616A..27V.title: Image Domain Gridding: a fast method for convolutional resampling of visibilities

nmse_details.scope: IDG vs classical gridding accuracy tests
nmse_details.evidence: Reports visibility-domain RMS error and residual-image RMS vs classical gridding, plus analytic aliasing energy — not NMSE/NRMSE by name. Flagged nmse_nrmse=1 from classification; left unspecified on this drill-down.

2023arXiv230606007K.title: HVOX: Scalable Interferometric Synthesis and Analysis of Spherical Sky Maps

nmse_details.scope: Direction-cosine and HEALPix accuracy sweeps vs direct point-source evaluation

execution_context.formula_scale: Fractional NMSE (requested vs achieved accuracy targets)
execution_context.reference: Direct evaluation of point-source sky model visibilities
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (SKA-Low-style setups; also LOFAR dirty demo without NMSE)

nmse_details.evidence: Controlled accuracy experiment measures NMSE between visibilities from direct point-source evaluation vs HVOX, chunked HVOX (500 MB partition limit), NIFTY (DUCC W-gridder), and NIFTY 2D without w-term. Monolithic HVOX tracks requested NMSE down to ≈10⁻⁹ (FINUFFT upsampling floor); chunked HVOX slightly misses targets due to summed-block error; HEALPix matches direction-cosine NMSE for HVOX.

nmse_details.scope: HVOX / chunked HVOX vs NIFTY and NIFTY 2D (no w-term) on visibility NMSE
nmse_details.baseline: NIFTY (DUCC W-gridder); NIFTY 2D without w-term; direct-evaluation target
nmse_details.evidence: NIFTY generally exceeds its requested accuracy by about one order of magnitude; omitting the w-term yields much larger error insensitive to the target. HEALPix requires NIFTY bilinear interpolation (≈1% error) before gridding — mesh-conversion loss isolated from restored-image quality.

nmse_details.unit: × (approx. order-of-magnitude overshoot of requested target by NIFTY)
nmse_details.scope: NIFTY achieved vs requested visibility NMSE
nmse_details.evidence: NIFTY typically beats the requested NMSE target by ≈1 order of magnitude; chunked HVOX needs tighter per-block targets to hit the global NMSE.

2024arXiv241023178C.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Fast Reconstruction Methods Using Augmented Equivariant Bootstrap: Application to Radio Interferometry

nmse_details.scope: EVIL-Deconv vs CLEAN and PnP (Table 2; 64×64 HST patches / MeerKAT PSFs)
nmse_details.evidence: Appendix A.2 defines NMSE [−dB] = −20·log₁₀(‖x⋆−x̂‖₂/‖x⋆‖₂). Median Table 2: CLEAN 4.2 dB, PnP (DnCNN) 16.3 dB, EVIL-Deconv 19.9 dB (with SSIM 0.970 at 51 ms).

nmse_details.scope: EVIL-Deconv reconstruction fidelity vs CLEAN and PnP
nmse_details.evidence: EVIL-Deconv median NMSE 19.9 dB beats PnP (16.3 dB) and CLEAN (4.2 dB) on the same simulated reconstruction benchmark used for the UQ study.
